angles.text: Powering the KID tier without rental hours: on the A1 CPU (4 cores, 23 GB) and local-town (8 GB), which of the surveyed artifacts (PrismML release, Cactus Needle, openjev, bitnet.cpp) could serve node-writing / probe / digest work at >= 10 tok/s and what quality proxy decides it; chains start with a $0 measurement on this box, name est tok/s, RAM, download GB, and the falsifier.

Local typed decisions: openjev or any surveyed open System-One-style model as a $0 substitute for TypeSafe jev at the graph's typed acts (verdict class, accept/demote, rebrief cut, next-call suggestion, slug choice); chains compare against hypothesis:lm-jev-typed-acts-replay's bars (top-1 >= 0.75, ECE <= 0.10) and name the replay corpus on this box.

A queryable substrate for the graph: Neon Postgres (branching, scale-to-zero) as the indexed mirror of .agi/nodes and the replay/decision store; chains name what stays in git (source of truth) vs what is mirrored, the sync mechanism, the free-tier limits, and the failure mode when the mirror and the graph disagree.
